events.title: Mini Junior High School Information Session
events.description: Discover the unique educational approach and student life at Mita International Science Academy Junior High School, where we strive to nurture creative thinkers, in this 30-minute information session.

events.title: Media Creation Seminar Film Screening
events.description: Welcome to a powerful world of film created by junior high students! Be captivated by an expressive music video and two short dramas. Please come and join us in the Audio-Visual Room!

events.title: Chorus Club MIF Performance 2026
events.description: We are excited to share the beauty of choral music with you! From traditional choral pieces to J-POP, we will perform a wide variety of songs. Please come and enjoy our performance in the Audio-Visual Room!

events.title: English Club: Model UN (MUN)
events.description: Club members representing different countries demonstrate real-time negotiation and decision making on global issues. Visitors can also participate by voting on draft resolutions.

events.title: Kotonohana
events.description: Enjoy the beautiful sounds of the koto, a traditional Japanese instrument, performed by the Koto Club. Each member will put their heart into the performance and do their very best!

events.title: Pop Dance Club 2026 MIF Performance -Epilogue-
events.description: A five-month culmination created by 140 dancers. With “Epilogue” as our theme, we present a special performance that marks the closing of one chapter of our club.

events.title: Still, By Your Side
events.description: This is a heartwarming story about young game creators who clash over on their project, confront the feelings they have kept inside, and find their way back to the bonds they once shared.

events.title: Rhythmic Gymnastics Club Performance
events.description: We will present a rhythmic gymnastics performance inspired by Studio Ghibli’s masterpiece Princess Mononoke. Using skills and apparatus unique only to rhythmic gymnastics, we will bring the world of Princess Mononoke to life.

events.title: Physical expression
events.description: Through plays, dances, and other forms of performance, each class will express the interesting aspects and changes of different periods in different countries, with each class connecting them to its own theme, while the entire grade works together as one.

events.title: Harmony in the Sky ~2026 Wind Orchestra Concert~
events.description: Experience the breathtaking sound of a wind orchestra made up of over 120 students! Let the music take you beyond the skies—come join us on an unforgettable journey!

events.title: Volleyball
events.description: You can experience playing volleyball with our volleyball club members using soft volleyballs! No prior experience is necessary! Come join us and have fun passing the ball and keeping it in the air!

events.title: Takuripusu (Table Tennis Challenge)
events.description: Join our interactive event! After learning table tennis basics, test your skills against the club members using fun items like serving trays as rackets!

events.title: LET'S Track and Field!!
events.description: Experience five track and field events—50m sprint, long jump, high jump, javelic ball, and hurdles—with your performance measured, and have fun!

events.title: MITA Tennis Club Experience
events.description: You can see how the members of MITA Tennis Club practices, encourages, and cooperates with each other. You can also try playing tennis.
